plugins.Name: QuickTransfer
plugins.Description: Automate inventory transfers with Shift/Ctrl/Alt + Right-Click. Trade window, vendor quick sell, FC chest.

plugins.Author: Kage
plugins.Name: Relic Tracker
plugins.Punchline: Track relic materials across inventory and retainers.
plugins.Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job, with live material counts and optional FFXIV Collect sync.
plugins.Changelog:
- Artisan craft button uses step IDs (needs Artisan update).
- Fix frame hitching in loot-heavy zones (e.g. Eureka Hydatos).
- Right-click relics, replicas, materials, and armor to jump to Relic or Tracker.
- Armor pieces track from inventory; higher tiers (and Phantom Vision / Augmented Law's Order) credit lower sets.
- Cosmic tool stages and replicas count as owned. Progress is saved per character.
